historical_reviews.deepseek: Its passive query family is plausible only after exact names are enumerated. The label does not define LP or which chip is measured, and the truncated fallback cannot prove eight channels.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly refuses to infer LP/chip semantics. This review additionally requires chip PN/function/board location and explicitly separates the next row's transceiver temperature.
historical_reviews.duplicate_search: No duplicate code exists; TEMP_LP1~8_TRX cannot satisfy LP chip-temperature coverage even if indices align.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 requires every range member, ED-36 makes LP topology and device semantics readiness inputs, and ED-38 protects logs/thermal state and engineer verdict ownership.

original_test_intent: Validate the designated chip temperature on every applicable LP1–LP8 assembly, proving each sensor's board/device identity, readable current value and enabled thresholds across exact IPMI evidence and both BMC-Web views.
original_method: The platform owner defines LP, enumerates fitted LP1–LP8 assemblies and the monitored chip on each, maps exact SDR/Web records and supplies device-specific thermal limits; automation gathers complete passive evidence for operator comparison.
manual_activity: The board/platform owner defines LP, identifies the fitted LP1–LP8 assemblies and monitored chip PN/function/location on each, supplies thermal limits and confirms each corresponding Dashboard and Server Health entry.
required_inputs: Authoritative LP meaning and LP1–LP8 assembly/slot/connector topology
Fitted-member applicability and monitored chip vendor/device/PN/function per LP
Sensor source as on-die, external diode or board probe and exact physical location
Exact per-member SDR name/record/entity and Dashboard/Server Health mapping
Units, scale, tolerance, polling/freshness and unavailable semantics
Expected range and enabled thresholds under documented link/load/ambient/cooling state
Secret-safe access, complete capture, no-clear policy and independent thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Do not expand LP or infer the monitored chip without the approved topology/specification
Enumerate exact LP1–LP8 sensor names; a tilde range is not an IPMI sensor identifier
Keep chip sensors distinct from LP transceiver sensors and their limits
Bind each reading to a fitted physical assembly and chip measurement source
Retain full SDR and enabled threshold flags; no 100-line truncation
Do not alter chip/link state, clocks, firmware, fans, thresholds, BMC or logs
Stop on missing/stale/invalid reading, chip/link thermal anomaly, threshold mismatch or management instability; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source identity, LP topology and chip identity per member
Capture complete read-only SDR/Sensor inventory and exact LP chip results
Parse value, units, state, freshness and enabled thresholds
Build LP assembly/chip parity and prepare both Web entries
Correlate passive link, error, fan, SEL and BMC health without using TRX evidence
Perform no link/chip control, firmware, threshold or verdict action
engineer_actions: Define LP and approve fitted assembly/chip map
Approve sensor source, operating context and thresholds
Confirm both Web mappings and not-applicable members
Review each chip channel and issue the overall result

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only exact queries will contribute after member discovery, but `'TEMP_LP1~8_Chip'` is not an eight-member expansion; the fallback is incomplete, secrets are exposed and chip/Web identity is missing.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using secret-safe OOB access, retain the full SDR inventory and query every owner-mapped LP chip record separately, preserving threshold flags and assembly/device identity, then compare with both Web views.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: LP1~8_Chip scope, Dashboard and Server Health paths, reading/threshold criterion and 1/1-minute estimates remain; LP meaning, chip identity and limits are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES LP ASSEMBLY/CHIP AND THRESHOLD PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an eight-member assembly-to-chip sensor matrix, collect exact passive records with device/load context and reconcile enabled thresholds across raw and both Web views.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces label-only range collection with physical board and semiconductor provenance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A transceiver temperature, one literal result or a generic SDR excerpt cannot prove each LP's designated chip temperature and thresholds.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readback is passive, but wrong chip or board attribution can conceal a local hotspot or misapply device limits.

project_override_considerations: Unfitted LP positions require explicit not-applicable decisions. If multiple LPs share one physical sensor or use different chip revisions, document the approved fan-out or per-revision limit table rather than copying results.
expected_evidence: Approved LP definition and LP1–LP8 physical applicability map
Per-member chip vendor/device/PN/function, measurement source and location
Exact SDR/Web identity, value, units, state, freshness and enabled thresholds
Documented link/load/cooling/ambient context and device-specific limits
Complete redacted SDR plus exact member outputs with status/timestamps
Dashboard/Server Health evidence plus passive link/error/fan/SEL/BMC health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets LP1–LP8 chip temperature sensors and Web thresholds. LP/chip definitions and values are omitted but no alternative sensor target is asserted.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive per-LP chip thermal check is identifiable. Assembly topology, chip identity and thresholds are supplyable project readiness inputs under ED-36.

review_improvement: Adds assembly and semiconductor provenance, enforces true eight-member coverage and prevents adjacent transceiver temperature or truncated output from substituting for chip evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The suffix `Chip` is not enough to identify a thermal limit: an LP assembly may contain switching, retimer, controller or other silicon, and an external probe may not equal junction temperature. Per-member device and sensor-source attribution is necessary before comparing values or thresholds, while the adjacent TRX row must remain a separate thermal domain.
